2607.12397.title: Critic Experience Bank: Self-Evolving Step-Level Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
2607.12397.paper_summary: LLM agents act in external environments where each action changes the state that later decisions condition on, and where a single wrong step can waste interaction budget or trigger irreversible side effects long before the final failure is observed. Reliable deployment therefore requires \emph{step-level confidence estimation}: a calibrated probability that each proposed action is productive, available \emph{before} the action is executed. Existing LLM confidence estimators are designed to score a response from the given prompt, but agent confidence also depends on execution consequences: whether similar actions in similar situations actually advanced the task after the environment responded. We introduce the \method (\methodshort), a self-evolving critic framework in which an LLM critic accumulates evidence from its own past judgments and their observed consequences. After each trajectory, a hindsight LLM that sees the full execution feedback votes on whether each step was productive. The resulting pseudo-labels populate a memory bank from which related productive and unproductive experiences are retrieved into the critic's prompt whenever a similar step recurs. \methodshort requires no training and uses no ground truth step labels. Across three agent benchmarks and three critic backbones, \methodshort attains the best calibration (ECE and Brier) and ranking (AUC) in every dataset--critic combination, reducing ECE by up to $54\%$ relative to the strongest training-free baseline.
2607.12397.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理在外部環境中行動，每個行動都會改變後續決策所依賴的狀態，而單一錯誤的步驟可能會浪費互動預算或在最終失敗被觀察到之前觸發不可逆的副作用。因此，可靠的部署需要 \emph{步驟級信心評估}：在執行行動之前，對每個提議行動的生產性進行校準的概率。現有的 LLM 信心評估器旨在對給定提示的回應進行評分，但代理的信心也取決於執行後果：在環境反應後，類似情況下的類似行動是否實際推進了任務。我們介紹了 \method (\methodshort)，這是一個自我演變的評價框架，其中 LLM 評價者從其過去的判斷及其觀察到的後果中累積證據。在每條軌跡之後，一個能夠看到完整執行反饋的回顧 LLM 對每一步是否具有生產性進行投票。由此產生的伪標籤填充了一個記憶庫，當類似步驟重現時，相關的生產性和非生產性經驗會被檢索到評價者的提示中。 \methodshort 不需要訓練，也不使用真實的步驟標籤。在三個代理基準和三個評價者骨幹中，\methodshort 在每個數據集與評價者組合中達到了最佳的校準（ECE 和 Brier）和排名（AUC），相對於最強的無訓練基線，將 ECE 降低了高達 $54\%$。
